items.title: Confirm preferred appointment date for meter reading/smoke detector maintenance
items.quote: Bitte teilen Sie uns innerhalb von 7 Arbeitstagen (Mo.–Fr., ohne Feiertage) nach Briefdatum mit, an welchem der vorgeschlagenen Termine der Zugang zu Ihrer Wohnung möglich ist.
items.computation: This is a private (non-authority) deadline running 'nach Briefdatum' (from the letter date), so no delivery-fiction days are added; the period starts directly from the printed letter date 22.12.2025. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (22.12.2025) is not counted, so counting begins 23.12.2025. The period is 7 'Arbeitstage' (Mon–Fri, holidays excluded; per the stated rule 24 and 31 Dec count as working days). Counting forward: 23.12 (Tue, day1), 24.12 (Wed, day2, still a working day per rule), 25.12 (Thu, Christmas Day – holiday, excluded), 26.12 (Fri, 2nd Christmas Day – holiday, excluded), 27–28.12 (Sat/Sun, excluded), 29.12 (Mon, day3), 30.12 (Tue, day4), 31.12 (Wed, day5, working day per rule), 01.01.2026 (Thu, New Year – holiday, excluded), 02.01.2026 (Fri, day6), 03–04.01 (Sat/Sun, excluded), 05.01.2026 (Mon, day7). The 7th Arbeitstag is 05.01.2026, which itself is a normal Monday (no weekend/holiday shift needed).
